mapper.insert: INSERT INTO billing_settings (id, tenant_key, external_customer_id, billing_email, company_name, billing_address, tax_id, tax_id_type, currency, profile_owner_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id}::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), #{tenantKey}, #{externalCustomerId}, #{billingEmail}, #{companyName}, #{billingAddress}::jsonb, #{taxId}, #{taxIdType}, COALESCE(#{currency}, 'USD'), #{profileOwnerId}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, now()))
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_key, external_customer_id, billing_email, company_name, billing_address, tax_id, tax_id_type, currency, profile_owner_id, created_at, updated_at FROM billing_settings WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey}

SELECT id, tenant_key, external_customer_id, billing_email, company_name, billing_address, tax_id, tax_id_type, currency, profile_owner_id, created_at, updated_at FROM billing_settings WHERE external_customer_id = #{externalCustomerId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM billing_settings WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey})
mapper.update: UPDATE billing_settings SET external_customer_id = #{externalCustomerId}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey}

UPDATE billing_settings SET external_customer_id = #{externalCustomerId}, billing_email = #{billingEmail}, company_name = #{companyName}, billing_address = #{billingAddress}::jsonb, tax_id = #{taxId}, tax_id_type = #{taxIdType}, currency = #{currency}, profile_owner_id = #{profileOwnerId}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey}
UPDATE billing_settings SET profile_owner_id = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE profile_owner_id = #{profileOwnerId}::uuid
